fields.label: Key
fields.description: The key code asks for, e.g. student_register_series. Read-only and code-owned: an unregistered key is a bug, not a missing value, so the registry is a seed rather than a form

fields.label: Label
fields.description: What a Trust Admin sees when overriding it

fields.label: Value Type
fields.options:
Data
Int
Float
Check
Select
Link
fields.description: How a stored value is read back. Values are stored as Data so that a blank is distinguishable from a zero - the same reasoning as Field Policy Rule's bounds - and cast on read

fields.label: Options
fields.description: For Select, the permitted values one per line. For Link, the target doctype. Ignored otherwise

fields.label: Default
fields.description: The answer when nothing in the chain states one. Blank means there is no default, which is only legitimate if is_required is off

fields.label: Is Required
fields.description: Whether resolving to nothing is an error. On for a key code cannot proceed without - the register series - and off for one where absence is a real answer

fields.label: Institution Type Field
fields.description: The Institution Type column that answers this key at type scope, if there is one. Where it is set, the column is the ONLY source at that level - never a Config Value row beside it - so one level of the chain has one source. See erp/config/resolver.py

fields.label: Description
fields.description: What this key decides, and what each value means
